categoryEntries.name: ⟨statue⟩
categoryEntries.comment: Statue (at least one model part) — Terracotta Army

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: The model’s Shooting Weapon always hits on a roll equal to or greater than its Aim.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Units entirely with Autonomous may perform March Moves as normal despite being Undead, even when outside the range of the Commanding Presence of any friendly models.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
-1. The bearer counts towards Entombed.
If taken by a Character, the bearer gains Ambush (Open Terrain).
If taken by a Rank-and-File model, the bearer’s unit gains Ambush (Open Terrain), and additional models cannot be added to the unit during Army List creation.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Unless the model has Height 5, or only has model parts with Beast and/or Statue, it gains +1 Arm, Metal Armour, and loses Light Armour (if it has it).
A model with Mount cannot benefit from this +1 Arm more than once.
If an army includes any model with Barrow Legion, then all models in the Army List must have Barrow Legion.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +1 HP and loses one instance of Weakness (Flaming Attacks).

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
The bearer can cast a unique Bound Spell:
Unfinished Duty: Casting Value (4+), Range 12", Augment and Aura. Duration: Instant.
Choose one of the following effects for each target: [leftmargin=*]
  • The Rank-and-File part of the target Raises a number of HP equal to its Resurrected value.
  • One model in the target Recovers a number of HP equal to its Resurrected value.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model’s base size is changed to 100×100 mm, it gains two additional Skeletal Horse model parts, Fly, Solitary and loses Exclusive.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: Artillery, Area Attack (2×2), Direct Hit (Multiple Wounds (2)), If this weapon causes any HP loss, the target must immediately take a Panic Test.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Terracotta Army, and a Pharaoh must be the General.
Other units in the Army List must be upgraded with Terracotta Army.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
At the start of every friendly Player Turn, the wearer may lose Undying Will.
If so, choose a friendly unit within 12": this unit gains Undying Will, with Duration: One Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Spells cast by this unit gains +12" Range.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Each time this model successfully casts a Learned Spell of Type Augment or Universal, choose one of the following effects, for a single targeted friendly unit: [leftmargin=*]
  • The Rank-and-File part of the target Raises a number of HP equal to its Resurrected value.
  • A single model in the target Recovers a number of HP equal to its Resurrected value. This effect cannot be applied more than twice on the same Health Pool in each Magic Phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
At the end of each of your Player Turns, if there are no friendly models with Hierophant on the Battlefield, each unit containing Dust to Dust loses X HP, where X is equal to half their Resurrected value (rounding fractions up).
These hits can only be allocated onto models with Dust to Dust.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Units entirely with Ensouled Statue reduce by 1 the number of HP lost due to Dust to Dust and Unstable.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
All models in the bearer’s unit gain Autonomous.
In addition: One use only. Duration: One Turn.
During a friendly Movement Phase, the bearer’s unit's Mob is set to 8.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks with Multiple Wounds (X) against the model halve the number of wounds they inflict (rounding fractions up).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model’s Resurrected value is set to 1, and it gains Aegis (3+ against non-Magical Attacks), Aegis (5+), Ghost Step, Magical Attacks, Spirit, and loses Hard Target (1) and Skirmisher.
Cannot be taken with Ambush.
Max. 4 models/unit, and Rare.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: Area Attack (1×5), Direct Hit (Str 6, Multiple Wounds (D3)), Aspis Arrows

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+1 Att, Divine Attacks and Multiple Wounds (2, against Aegis (X+)*).
*Note that the latter also applies towards models with Aegis Saves with conditional applications.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: Aspis Arrows, Shoot in Extra Rank

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: An Undying Dynasties army must include at least one model with Hierophant.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model benefits from Fury while a Pharaoh or Nomarch is joined to its unit.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
The wielder gains Hierophant.
In addition, the wielder can cast Danse Macabre (Evocation) as a Bound Spell (3+).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Barrow Legion, and a Pharaoh must be the General.
Other units in the Army List must be upgraded with Barrow Legion.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: Stand and Shoot, Hits Automatically, Unmodifiable, *To-wound rolls are set to 5+

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Learned Spells cast by friendly Wizards within 12" of one or more models with Sacred Ark gain +6" Range (Aura spells gain +3" Range instead).

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The first time each Magic Phase that the bearer fails a Casting Roll for a Learned Spell that was targeting a friendly unit, the bearer may reroll all Magic Dice for this Casting Roll.

characteristics.name: Armour Enchant
characteristics.$text: The wearer’s Mobility is set to 8, and gains Autonomous, Fly, and Sweeping Attack (2D6, Str 2, AP 1).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Hierophant and Wizard Apprentice with access to Cosmology, Divination, and Evocation.

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: Permanent.
During Pre-game Selections, choose a Field, Forest, or Water Terrain, that has not been placed during Pre-game selections: it ceases to be the Terrain Feature it used to be and loses its Terrain Rules.
It becomes a Desert Terrain Feature with Dangerous Terrain (6+) for all enemy units.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text: The bearer’s unit gains +1 Mob and Ghost Step.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
If the Death Cult Hierarch’s chosen Path of Magic is:
  • Evocation: whenever the model casts a Spell of Type Augment or Universal on a friendly unit, you may activate Death is only the Beginning on any friendly unit within 18" of the model instead of one of the units the spell was cast on.
  • Any other Path of Magic: the model knows Whispers of the Veil (Evocation) in addition to its other spells.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Models without Statue have their Rsr set to 1, gain +1 Res, Statue, Ensouled Statue, and lose Dust to Dust.
If an army includes any model with Terracotta Army, then all models in the Army List must have Terracotta Army.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Start of Vanguard Units (Battle Setup, 3.F), and at the start of each friendly Player Turn, choose a friendly unit containing Statue within 18": all models with Statue gains Regeneration (5+). Duration: One Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model part gains Fury and Lethal Strike.
In addition, it counts as a Rank-and-File model for the purposes of Undying Will.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Rank-and-File model parts with Skeleton in units containing Undying Will gain +2 Def, +2 Off, Lethal Strike, Magical Attacks, and replace their Shooting Weapons’ Aim with (4+).
Model parts with Mount are not affected by Undying Will.
